translations.web: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.
translations.bsb: So practice and observe everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.
translations.kjv: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
translations.asv: all things therefore whatsoever they bid you, these do and observe: but do not ye after their works; for they say, and do not.
